The '''Kriselist system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Wornal sector/Legends|Wornal sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kriselist/Legends|Kriselist]].
